deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v2.14.0 -> service=inference-api | global rollout=10% | regions: eu-west=10%, us-central=10% | change-window=2026-03-20T02:00Z-04:00Z
jen: smoke tests kicked off in eu-west, basic prompts look good
mike: quick baseline check: eu-west p50/p95 look fine, us-central p95 a bit elevated (~+12%)
sophia: i'm seeing a cluster of 5xx traces from us-central, pulling logs now @mike
mike: logs snippet from us-central:
```
2026-03-20 02:12:34 ERROR inference-api kvcache: OOM on shard=7 alloc=1.2GiB
2026-03-20 02:12:35 WARN retries=3 request_id=fn_72a
```
sophia: recommendation: pause traffic to us-central, keep eu-west at 10% to maintain rollout progress
jen: agree. prefer to pin us-central back to v2.13.9 while we triage. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: executing policy -> set rollout us-central=0% and pin region target=v2.13.9 (reason: kvcache OOM)
ops-oncall: creating rollback runbook and paging infra team now
mike: running rollback command (dry-run then exec):
```
/deploy rollback --service inference-api --region us-central --to v2.13.9 --reason "kvcache OOM on shard 7"
```
deploy-bot: rollback queued, scheduled for immediate apply in 30s window
jen: adding short note to release notes: "Paused us-central due to kvcache OOM; rolled back to v2.13.9. eu-west continues at 10%."
sophia: filed ticket INF-3456 -> https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3456 (kvcache OOM investigation)
ops-oncall: Holdcall decision: STOP for us-central rollout. Re-eval in 30m at 02:45Z. Notifying downstream owners.
mike: capture trace ids + example request payloads and attach to INF-3456
jen: also request extended kvcache metrics retention for the next 2 hours to help debugging
deploy-bot: status update -> traffic shift applied: eu-west=10%, us-central=0% (us-central pinned to v2.13.9)
jen: thanks all — we'll triage, validate a fix, then re-open staged rollout when safe :wave:
ops-oncall: follow-ups captured: add circuit-breaker default for kvcache OOM (trigger at 5% 5xx), add alert on kvcache allocation >80%, increase PV retention for 2h
sophia: assigning INF-3456 to eng-runtime (priority=P0) and adding initial debugging checklist
mike: i'll prepare a terse ops-channel deploy note and update runbook with rollback command examples
jen: :thumbsup:
